semantic_comparisons.distinction: Existing boss-owned reason/cooldown sends explicit invalid/too-far reason. Here no server cooldown and no failed-requirement witness; client recomputes current requirements from a stack. Four message categories do not earn4.

Existing server-produced textual failure delivered to chat signature replacement. Here packet omits condition list/state and HUD independently reconstructs it from local config and separately synced current skill data. Single slot/replacement alone is overlapping support, not proposed distinction.

Existing actor qualification final denial submits first explicit reason. Reskillable actor eligibility also generic and not new credit alone; proposed distinction is a complete item-only receipt consumed as live local explanation rather than server-reason snapshot.

Existing failure-driven world hint with source-owned shared1200-tick cadence and visibility attempts. Here static screen HUD and unconditional per-message40 reset; neither time value nor translation/category earns credit.

Existing prediction lifecycle matches server declaration and expires unconfirmed casts. Reskillable display has no nonce/declaration reconciliation, no server clearance and no cancellation upon successful retry; hiding is only client clock or replacement.

Existing final denial lost before success settlement. Here genericEnforce really cancels its event; possible green requirements under a red rejection header are live client re-evaluation, not evidence that server denial was lost or action succeeded.

Closest single-slot HUD owner already covers overwrite/tick/fade/world-key absence. Do not count those again or40 versus20. Possible new whole family is actual server refusal serialized as item+category, combined on every render with independently synced current skill state/local lock definitions, including omitted requirement types. If coordinator treats that as same family, merge0.
Existing reason production separated from attempt debounce. Reskillable has no server attempt throttler and every decoded packet resets HUD; lack of debounce is a limit, not new credit.

Existing live local charge polling and S2C counter feed one shield resource HUD. It does not reconstruct a historical rejected action requirement list from packet item plus separate mutable profile and local lock rules; no recharge/slot/poll helper credit here.

Existing two entity IDs actively reconstruct a gameplay effect with missing amplifier/duration. Here detail reconstruction only explains actor qualification, never reapplies the rejected action or effect. Entity-ID validation and generic reconstruction alone are not a new unit.

Existing overlay independently recalculates current shared healing budget without a historical refusal-specific item/category receipt. Distinct causal join is retained here as one full denial-explanation policy, not another generic overlay or local recomputation credit.

complete_semantic_decision_read.trigger: 官方技能玩法：登录/每玩家tick获取PlayerData，首次从PlayerPersisted/SkillableData载入；服务器升级/解锁后saveAndSync，重读数据由装备/方块/攻击等级锁和真实特性事件消费。不是声明Clone成功，也不按8技能/17trait分计。
complete_semantic_decision_read.input: player.entityData[EntityPlayer.PERSISTED_NBT_TAG][SkillableData].SkillLevels[skill.getKey()]={level:int,skillPoints:int,unlockables:compound keyed by unlockable.getKey→boolean}。PlayerData运行cache按int hash和WeakReference区分实例；客户端网络NBT同步同格式。
complete_semantic_decision_read.output: getDataCompoundForPlayer仅缺键时建compound，保留历史样式SkillableData键名；未见把别的旧namespace数据映射到reskillable技能名的代码，不能把沿用名字或dot→colon编码声称旧版本迁移保证。Skill/Unlockable构造name把ResourceLocation冒号改点，writer用getKey；unlockables读时全部点替冒号再registry查询，是现行反编码。未知registry返回null忽略、非法ResourceLocation无逐项catch；只按键存在收集，不读取布尔true/false，因此false键也作为解锁。保存用全新SkillLevels和unlockables compound，未知技能/trait不旁存，将在对应重写时丢出活动格式。
complete_semantic_decision_read.preservation: PlayerData构造为每注册Skill建默认level1并respec，load仅对存在的skill键加载，缺整组保留构造或旧内存值，不主动清未出现技能；PlayerSkillInfo加载整数直接赋值、clear解锁后重建，不调用onUnlock。getLevel消费时将<=0校正1、>cap校正cap，但getRank/isCapped/saveToNBT可直接用原值，skillPoints无对应clamp。getKey表达式实际是hashCode << (1+sideOffset)，不是UUID或保证唯一ID；同key缓存WR不是本player就save旧数据→remove→递归get新对象并load→用旧快照load覆盖。cleanup仅每END移除weakref已空项目，未见全会话清理/显式Clone事件，原生PlayerPersisted重生如何复制未在本源验证。 Master: 主责全文读166唯一方法及14声明，4完整context块，官方fixed commit/tree/blob/方法AST逐项核验。一个PlayerPersisted SkillableData永久技能档家族1，8技能/17trait/等级/点数/同步/装备锁/特性均不拆，非泛基础设施。getKey实际hashCode左移(1+side)且WR对象不同时serialize旧对象→删除cache→新构造load→旧快照覆盖，不能说按UUID安全跨死亡Clone；cleanup只清空WR。现行dot↔colon编码不是未知老namespace兼容alias。load只处理出现skill不清未出现旧值，unlockables按key集合无视false，未知registry忽略并新compound重写丢弃；非法ResourceLocation未逐项隔离。完整实际等级门槛与扣XP/点数流程已读，未知skill/null、parentSkill关联未验证只记静态限制。永久解锁与根entityData Undershirt200tickCD分开，符合本修复永久/瞬态边界，但本源未出现Clone回调不宣称死亡已验收。来源Skillable旧仓重定向官方Reskillable不另计；ExperienceHelper OpenMods派生只支持0，与已有其他技能树不同实际owner实现非换键clone。
complete_semantic_decision_read.application_limit: 真实服务器MessageLevelUp用ctx玩家、registry技能、等级/XP/cancel event，再扣XP/levelUp/saveAndSync；unlock包校验未解锁/点数/requirements和可取消事件，但未显式验证传入skill是unlockable.parentSkill，未知skill/trait缺少完整null隔离。LevelLockHandler在可取消实际右击/攻击/破坏/装备事件通过SkillRequirement.getLevel判断；Undershirt对已解锁特性分派hurt(血>=6且致死且可阻挡时改health-1并设200CD)与tick减CD，永久解锁和临时状态可明确区分。原生事件、PlayerPersisted Clone、Forge registry缺失行为、客户端UI/原生网络未运行；没有宣称获得进度必跨死亡保留或恶意包已复现。ExperienceHelper注释来自OpenModsLib，仅支持消耗路径，无额外外部研究credit。 固定上游源码静态审阅，不直接移植跨版本API，不宣称原生运行验证。未执行上游操作或游戏；固定AA 1.12.2源码不能替代当前Dynasty原生验收。

complete_chain_observations: registered concrete producer: Reskillable @Mod constructor installs API/provider; preInit dispatches sided proxy. CommonProxy registers LevelLockHandler/PlayerData events, initializes config and PacketHandler; postInit setupLocks builds actual keys. Registry subscriber creates/registers skills including concrete attack. Default config includes iron_sword wildcard attack5. Skill enabled/default cap32 and default PlayerSkillInfo level1 establish a concrete conditional denial example with that config, not only abstract callbacks. ItemInfo equality ignores metadata in hash but honors wildcard in equality, matching actual sword metadata; NBT/mod lock helpers fully read as context0.

actual qualification refusal: LivingAttackEvent with true source EntityPlayer reads that actor current MAINHAND at damage event time, not necessarily original projectile weapon. genericEnforce skips noncancelable/null/empty/creative; default enforceFakePlayers includes fake denial but suppresses fake feedback, alternative skips fake. PlayerData.matchStats returnsfalse at first unmet requirement. Event is canceled and tellPlayer sends only to EntityPlayerMP. Default branch cancels before send; alternate sends before cancel. Other block/use/armor routes share categories but are not additional families. Current armor route is not canceling event; it copies/returns or drops invalid armor, clears armor slot then sends. No final aggregate result after every other mod handler is claimed.

item plus category transport: MessageLockedItem constructor stores stack reference, not copy; byte codec serializes ItemStack and UTF8 message key only. No failing requirement, threshold, server level, target UUID, world, nonce or action generation. PacketHandler registers actual CLIENT handler. onMessage schedules on Minecraft task queue, handleMessage calls HUDHandler.setLockMessage. No local player/world/current item revalidation before updating static slot. ByteBufUtils/native network scheduling internals not expanded; do not assert enqueue-time immutable stack snapshot.

separate live profile data: Login PlayerData.sync→API→ReskillableModAccess sends MessageDataSync with saveToNBT snapshot of SkillLevels. Client scheduled handler resolves current player through ClientProxy and loadFromNBT→PlayerSkillInfo overwrites level/points/unlocks for included skills. MessageLevelUp actual server handler can levelUp then saveAndSync after its gates; exact XP-helper internals not expanded or credited. No action ID binds these data packets to a particular MessageLockedItem. ConfigHandler reads local lock configuration; config-change load only replaces pending configLocks and does not itself call setupLocks. No same-time configuration/version field in refusal packet.

real client consumer recomputes explanation: ClientProxy registers HUDHandler and ClientTickHandler. On overlay ALL while lockTime>0, HUD reads current local player data and LevelLockHandler.getSkillLock(lockedItem) every render. Draws translated refusal category header red, then skill icons and requested level numbers red/green according to current local skill level. GuiSkills.drawSkill uses current profile rank and texture; RenderHelper submits concrete textured quad. Thus packet reports rejection category/item while detailed condition explanation is reconstructed from current local definitions and independently synced profile, not server failure witness. It lists all local skill/advancement requirements, not only the one that failed.

render coverage and early exit boundaries: RequirementRegistry supports skill, adv and trait; HUD separates only SkillRequirement and AdvancementRequirement. Trait/custom requirements still contribute restriction count/box size but are absent from shown detail list. Advancement icons/text show no achieved-state color check. An unresolved advancement causes return after outer pushMatrix and before matching final popMatrix; null display has no guard. This is a static incomplete-restore path, not a runtime graphics failure claim. Ordinary main skill text calls font renderer; translation resources/nativeGL/pixels not evaluated. No asset changed.

explicit lifespan and exits: setLockMessage replaces static item/message and sets40 on every receipt, with no dedup or throttle. END client tick decrements only when currentScreen null or doesGuiPauseGame false. World-null branch only PlayerDataHandler.cleanup; no HUD clear, dimension/actor key, dead-player clear, successful retry clear or item-switch clear. lockTime<=0 prevents drawing; stored item/message refs are retained. Last<10 uses partialTicks alpha clamped minimum0.05. Repeated receipts can prolong display; pausing can preserve remaining clock. Rendering is not explicitly filtered Pre/Post beyond ElementType.ALL, so do not assert exactly one draw per frame.

Reskillable @Mod→sided proxy→registered LevelLockHandler and packet initialization→postInit setupLocks→actual iron-sword attack5 requirement. Under the explicitly assumed default enabled config, noncreative real actor at attack1 and cancelable event can reach actual denial. Not a default runtime or exploit reproduction.

LivingAttackEvent uses true-source player CURRENT main hand. Existing canceled event returns. genericEnforce skips null/empty/creative/noncancelable, cancels failed match; fake-player behavior controls cancellation and separate feedback suppression. Event authority is a mod action, not proof no other listener changes final settlement.

Actual CLIENT message registration and queued handle call feed HUD. Packet stores stack reference, not immutable enqueue snapshot; codec carries stack/category only, no failed-condition witness, threshold, target/world/action generation or profile revision. ByteBufUtils/Forge/Minecraft native1.12.2 internals were not substituted from1.20.1 or executed.

HUD reads current local PlayerData and current local lock lookup on EVERY qualifying render, then compares current levels against the local thresholds. It lists all local skill and advancement requirements, not just the failed one. Requirement satisfied now does not revoke the old refusal header or prove old action succeeded.

PlayerData sync uses a separately serialized SkillLevels snapshot, received by current client player and loaded by included skill key. The real MessageLevelUp path can update level/saveAndSync after its gates; saveAndSync is inside the sufficient-XP branch but outside the Pre-event-success branch, so a canceled Pre can still produce an unchanged sync. XP internals and successful transaction are not newly accepted.

Current skill rank icon is read before getLevel clamps, because GuiSkills.drawSkill calls getRank first. Numeric requirement text uses getLevel. Malformed loaded out-of-range values could differ in those source paths; no actual malformed profile or rendered corruption was tested. Old migration owner retains all persistence/clamping/unknown-key semantics.

TraitRequirement participates in matching through registered API handler yet HUD filters omit it while counting it in layout width. Advancement completion is not colored against actual achievement in HUD. Advancement-null returns after outer push and before pop; null display is unguarded. These bounded source paths are not independent credits, reproduced engine defects or a reason to patch upstream.

Config-change handler load replaces pending configLocks without invoking setupLocks; this is not proven live map rebuilding, even though independent client/server startup definitions may differ. No actual config mismatch or packet reorder observed.

Each received refusal overwrites the item/category slot and sets40. END tick decrements only on nonpausing screens. world-null only cleans weak PlayerData entries, not HUD slot; no success/item-switch/world/actor correlation clear in inspected consumers. Expiry suppresses draw but retains refs. These lifetime/overwrite features overlap SpellEngine HUD and add0.

No rendered Chinese text/icon/art/audio, TCP, native eligibility, Boss immunity, target gray text, survival acquisition or gameplay acceptance. No production Java, private QA/game, shared Jar, professional asset or task deletion. Ordinary constitution behavior remains untouched.
limitations: Proposed distinction is split authority: real server denial plus client-reconstructed current detailed explanation. Not another single-slot/fade/cooldown value reference.
A green local requirement under refusal header is not proof server allowed action or target is immune. No server failed-condition snapshot is transmitted.
Actor eligibility is not Boss target immunity. No actual immune grey-text/audio implementation claimed; ordinary constitution rules unchanged.
Profile synchronization is separate and lacks refusal correlation; do not claim network reorder observed, config mismatch reproduced or guaranteed delivery.
No real server admission bypass demonstrated. LivingAttackEvent cancellation is actual mod action but native Forge dispatch/cross-mod uncancel policy not exhaustively expanded.
40-tick lifetime is pause-gated client ticks, not a wall-clock guarantee or server rate limit. Slots retained after hidden, no world cleanup in searched classes/callers.
Config-change callback load does not rebuild live lock map; do not assert immediate runtime config mutation from editing a file.
Advancement-null restore and missing trait rendering are concrete bounded source observations, not independent credits or production patches.
Copied RenderHelper explicitly attributes Botania; shared rendering helper context0, not a new author/source family.
